profile.headline: Embedded Software Developer
profile.summary: Embedded Software Developer with hands-on experience in C, Embedded C, and C++, Linux system programming, and embedded software development. Strong understanding of Linux internals, Yocto Project, ARM-based systems, and peripheral driver development, with practical experience working with CAN, UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, and TCP/IP networking. Currently working in R&D at Suprajit Engineering Limited, contributing to embedded software development and Linux-based embedded systems.

highlights: Contributing to embedded software development and Linux-based embedded systems.

experience.trainingFocus: Automotive ECU Communication using CAN protocol - Hands-on Training
highlights: Developed and validated automotive ECU-to-ECU communication logic for vehicle control functions.
Implemented CAN message flow between ECUs for automotive indicators such as headlights and turn signals.
Designed control logic and validated system behavior under multiple test scenarios.
Executed debugging, integration testing, and functional verification in a real-time environment.

projects.title: Automated Employee Attendance System using RFID Technology
highlights: Designed and developed an RFID-based real-time attendance system using an LPC2129 ARM7 microcontroller to automate employee entry and exit tracking.
Used UART and SPI communication protocols to interface an RFID reader, ensuring reliable tag detection and data acquisition.
Developed Embedded C firmware for unique ID verification, attendance logging, and system control with optimized memory usage.

projects.title: Bus Reservation System
highlights: Developed a console-based bus reservation system using C programming.
Added automated email alerts for seat booking, cancellation, and availability updates.
Applied data structures for efficient record management.
Used file handling to store and retrieve booking data.

detailSourceNotes.detail: File handling to store and retrieve booking data.

projects.title: Multi-Client Chat Application (Linux IPC)
highlights: Constructed a server and multi-client chat application using message queues.
Implemented IPC mechanisms in Linux using C programming.
Tested communication across multiple terminals in a Linux environment.

projects.title: Smart Vehicle Parameter Monitoring System using High-Speed SPI and I2C Communication
highlights: Implemented a real-time vehicle parameter monitoring system by interfacing multiple sensors using high-speed SPI and I2C protocols on an embedded microcontroller.
Developed efficient data acquisition and processing algorithms to monitor vehicle metrics.

detailSourceNotes.detail: The fuller SPI/I2C implementation description and data acquisition algorithms are from source-3.
The unclear phrase "with impact accuracy" was omitted from the cleaned highlight; no accuracy improvement or metric is inferred.
detailSourceNotes.originalText: Developed efficient data acquisition and processing algorithms to monitor vehicle metrics with impact accuracy

projects.title: Intelligent Ultrasonic-Based Reverse Parking and Collision Avoidance System using CAN Protocol
highlights: Designed a real-time automotive safety system using ultrasonic sensors for obstacle distance detection.
Developed a collision prevention and reverse parking guidance system using ultrasonic sensors.
Implemented Embedded C algorithms for proximity detection and adaptive alerts, enabling reliable reverse parking.

projects.title: Home Automation using Bluetooth (Arduino)
highlights: Developed a Bluetooth-based home automation system using Arduino to remotely control household appliances through a mobile application.
Implemented wireless communication and relay interfacing for real-time device switching.

projects.title: Online Exam System (C++)
highlights: Structured an exam system using object-oriented programming concepts and file handling.
Implemented authentication for admin and user modules.
Added timer-based exam functionality.

projects.title: Load Frequency Control Optimization
highlights: Built and simulated a two-area interconnected power system.
Implemented PID, Fuzzy Logic, and ANFIS controllers.
Analyzed system stability and frequency deviation using MATLAB Simulink.
Compared controller performance based on response characteristics.

issues.description: Source-1 lists +91-8074453994; sources-2 and source-3 list +91-8074453995. Both values are retained and primary is null.

In every PDF, the printed LinkedIn path is /in/chenna-kesava-b47901228 while the embedded hyperlink points to /in/chennakesavab47901228. Both are retained and the primary URL is null. Only tracking query parameters were removed from the normalized embedded URL.
The parking project literally identifies the MCU as Ipc2129. LPC2129 appears elsewhere in the resumes, but that correction is not assumed for this project.
The source phrase "with impact accuracy" is unclear. The cleaned highlight retains the supported data acquisition and processing work; the original wording is preserved in the project note.

The Suprajit present/current wording comes from source-1, and the online exam ongoing wording comes from source-2. These statuses are preserved as reported, not verified as of the data sheet creation date.
